reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Galatasaray SK are favoured at 48%, against 29% for VfB Stuttgart and 23% for the draw. Elo separates them by only 5 points, so the edge is small. Over the last five: Galatasaray SK 1.2 points per game, VfB Stuttgart 2.0. They average 1.7 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.55 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 69%. Across their last five, Galatasaray SK and VfB Stuttgart have scored 1.8 and conceded 2.0 a game between them. VfB Stuttgart are the sharper of the two in front of goal right now, not Galatasaray SK.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
